subject.title: fix(slack): suppress room event typing indicators

question: Should this PR be treated as only the Slack typing/status repair while the linked issue remains open for `visibleReplies` semantics, or as full acceptance and resolution of the room-event `message_tool_only` policy?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded, but its closing reference would resolve an issue that also asks for a decision about configured automatic replies and documentation of the safety policy.

options.title: Merge narrow fix only
options.body: Land the typing suppression after live proof and keep the linked issue open for the remaining config and documentation decision.

options.title: Treat as full resolution
options.body: Accept room events as permanently tool-only and update the contract or documentation so configured automatic replies are not misleading.

options.title: Broaden delivery behavior
options.body: Change room-event source-delivery precedence so supported Slack turns can honor configured automatic replies, with broader cross-channel tests and upgrade review.

recommendation.title: Merge narrow fix only
recommendation.body: Land the typing suppression after live proof and keep the linked issue open for the remaining config and documentation decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the Slack dispatch lifecycle and they are best positioned to determine whether the linked policy issue is fully resolved.
